Messages.Author: Slytherin
Messages.Body:
I have tried a google search for this, but without much luck.

I am being bled by someone using Night Moves for 1. Obviously, with
Setites being the Intercept monsters that they are, I decide not to
block. :)

Hesha plays Ecstasy at Superior to reduce the bleed by 1 and cause the
burn blood effect.

Assuming that the bleed isn't now modified, and so here would be
resolving for 0.

Can Kephamos also play a Superior Ecstasy to reduce the bleed to -1 and
cause the burn blood effect?

Ditto for Allonzo Montoya, etc...

Ecstasy does state if the bleed resolves for 0 or less. I always
assumed that meant if you then drew and played a Superior Telepathic
Counter when the bleed was a 1, therefore going to -1 (can play more
than you need in one card, but not mulitple cards - Stealth/Intercept),
but last night I was wondering whether or not every SER guy you have
could all drop the bleed independently, potentially going down to -4+,
just to get the burn blood effect. This would have reduced the blood on
my predators vampires a lot quicker.

Just a thought for the next time I play Ecstasy.

Cheers

Andy
VEKN Setite Ruler of Cambridge

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
You can play as many Ecstasy as you want at Superior which reduces the
bleed by 1 for each card played, and once the bleed resolves (i.e. when
nobody wants to do anything more) then you check for the "if the bleed
resolves for 0 (or less), the acting minion burns 1 blood or life.".

So for each Ecstasy card, if the bleed was 0 or less, the acting minion
burns 1 blood or life. Four cards played, four blood/lives burned.

Archie
